critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx is 686 lines — exceeds the 700-line limit; consider splitting into sub-components (MarqueeAdmin, PricesAdmin, ContactAdmin, ImagesAdmin) for maintainability.
On mount, the verify call is fire-and-forget (no loading state shown to user). If network is slow, gear click can momentarily show login modal even when token is valid.
logout does not invalidate the JWT on the server-side — only clears localStorage. This is expected for stateless JWT but worth noting.
